text_4a47ee5a8057: Enter a group name and select at least one available contact.
text_ea80e77ac8e0: Image, short video or file (max. 10 MB)
text_c2992bcdb4ac: Use Create group to name a group chat and select at least one contact. You are automatically a member. All members can reply in the group. Existing chats have a distinct color. The top right shows up to 99 unread messages; opening marks displayed messages as read. View images and short videos up to 10 MB per attachment in the chat and download them with Save attachment.
text_f311dfebf58e: Duty times and the train journeys and GPS details tab appear after you open, load or create a work report. Duty roster is tile 2 directly after Work report in the portal.
